searchText: Has it been explained why we're not seeing anything involving Prysm in the recent strings of merge demonstrations? not _why_ but https://twitter.com/terencechain/status/1446196286630236161 All other teams are currently at the same location which makes working on it pretty easy (and fun!) aaah I see, that explains it That's actually what worried me the most about prysm situation 😅 if I'm not invited to a conference in my very narrow field I'm a little offended They were invited of course 🙈 They choose not to attend (I think due to covid/scheduling conflicts) I assumed so, still... Yes, all client teams were of course invited. Prysm is the only one where no one could come, but most teams also had reduced attendance due to COVID and other factors. Yes! we really wanted to come but unfortunately covid / scheduling conflict put a damper on things. We are catching up slowly and steadily. Thanks to all the participants for the hardwork and leading the way ❤️ What is the location of the interop? Pretty exciting to see the pics. Especially given the accelerated path the CL took after its interop meeting back then
